parsed.name: ZMQ值订阅组件
parsed.description: 一种非物理的软件消息组件，使用 ZeroMQ 从远程发布端订阅数值消息。在实验系统中可用于在不同进程、主机或模块之间接收实时参数、状态或测量值。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software messaging component that uses ZeroMQ to subscribe to value messages from a remote publisher. In laboratory systems, it can be used to receive real-time parameters, status updates, or measurement values between processes, hosts, or software modules.

actions.description: 运行订阅循环并轮询接收远程发布的数值消息。
actions.description_en: Run the subscriber loop and poll for value messages from a remote publisher.

actions.description: 关闭订阅组件并停止网络消息接收。
actions.description_en: Shut down the subscriber component and stop network message reception.
